Agenda
Item 1
Review of Committee Charter

The Review of Committee Charter was a review of the company's cybersecurity posture. Lisette Ozturk, the CISO, reported on a recent penetration test, which identified 111 critical vulnerabilities. The committee approved the budget for the proposed remediation plan.

Motion

To approve for funding: RESOLVED, that the meeting be adjourned.

Moved: Hemi Shimizu  •  Seconded: Joel Randall
Vote: 9 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Executive Session: CEO Performance Review

The meeting began with a review of the minutes from the prior session, which were approved without modification. The committee then turned to the main agenda item, Executive Session: CEO Performance Review. Norzaidi Yang provided a 15-minute summary, followed by a Q&A session.

Item 3
Capital Allocation Plan for FY2023

The committee discussed the Capital Allocation Plan for FY2023, a review of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The committee reviewed the company's periodic reports and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To defer: RESOLVED, that the Director Nominating Committee approves the revised compensation structure for Hanover Consulting as set forth in Exhibit C, and directs management to implement the approved changes no later than 2023-02-28.

Moved: Phuong Church  •  Seconded: Rahel Naidu
Vote: 9 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Workforce Analytics Initiative — Program Status

The committee discussed the Workforce Analytics Initiative — Program Status, a review of the company's compliance with the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). The committee reviewed the company's administration of its employee benefit plans and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To approve for growth: RESOLVED, that the Director Nominating Committee establishes an ad hoc subcommittee to further investigate the Workforce Analytics Initiative — Program Status and report its findings back to the full committee within 90 days.

Moved: Joel Randall  •  Seconded: Norzaidi Maxwell
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  4 Abstain  —  CARRIED
